svg.title: GazeBase S1: complete seven-notebook eye-tracking study
svg.desc: Five-band editable overview of all seven executed notebooks in Eye-Tracking Foundations and Signal Analysis, with a measured source gaze excerpt; source audit, preprocessing, event detection, feature extraction, participant bootstrap, threshold sensitivity and source-evidence reconciliation. Observed results include 10 participants, 40 source records, 2778008 gaze samples, 21728 algorithm-derived events, 16 task-feature statistics, and 40 matched record identities. No predictive or cognitive claim is made.

g.text: Seven executed notebooks · 10 participants · 40 recordings · measured gaze to bounded evidence

g.aria-label: Measured horizontal and vertical gaze excerpt from original GazeBase record S_1001_S1_FXS

g.text: Measured gaze and saved numerical outputs; vendor agreement is conditional, and no cognitive inference is tested.
Source audit → preprocessing → event detection → features → participant statistics → sensitivity → integrated evidence
